Follow-up next Wednesday.
— Nitin

Aditi, you're hiding your report card? Let your Zubin mama tell you what I did at your age.

In class ten, I failed chemistry. I told everyone I'd done fine. I told myself it didn't count, that the teacher hated me. For two weeks, I didn't look at the marks.

Finally, one evening, I told my grandmother. Only her. I said, "I failed." She held my hand and said, "Now we know. Now we can plan."

The next day I showed my teacher. We made a plan for the retest. I passed it.

The denial helped for a few days. But saying it out loud to one person, that's where things began to change.
